propositions: User identity differs between Cloud (opaque accountId) and Data Center (name), requiring a pluggable contract to prevent leaking this difference into core diff logic

PR #120's DC implementation used unreachable getattr-discovered resolver, causing permanently non-authoritative assignee resolution and churn; NameIdentity must perform real lookup and return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees
UserIdentityModel protocol defines resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) tuple and to_payload(value) for assignee field shape
NameIdentity resolver is injected explicitly at construction, not discovered via getattr, eliminating unreachable branches and ensuring DC converges on assignee changes
Parameterized contract tests over both implementations verify all three resolution states (empty, converged, differing) and that unresolvable assignees raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError
